verdict.rationale: TruffleHog ships a headless, scriptable CLI and documented pre-commit/pre-receive git hooks that block commits containing secrets, which could be wired into an agent's commit pipeline to scan AI-generated code before it lands (trufflehog-docs-5, trufflehog-docs-13, trufflehog-probe-7). However, there is no evidence of any purpose-built integration, SDK, or MCP-style hook specifically for coding agents (e.g., Copilot/Cursor/Claude Code) — only generic git-hook and CLI wiring aimed at human developer workflows. missing for 10: explicit coding-agent/AI-agent integration (MCP server, agent plugin, or documented agent-specific hook)
